# Pool Builders Central Coast

Pool Builders Central Coast (https://poolbuilderscentralcoast.com.au/) is a free referral and quote service for people who want pool building work on the Central Coast, New South Wales, Australia. It does not build pools itself. Enquiries from the quote form are passed to one local pool builder who services the customer's area, and that business contacts the customer directly.

## Important facts
- No phone number is published on the site.
- The site does not publish its own prices, reviews or ranking claims. Cost guides cite named public sources.
- Rules pages summarise official NSW government and council sources, with links.
- Contact for enquiries and privacy requests: quotes@poolbuilderscentralcoast.com.au.
